evidence.original_label: 主营业务分地区情况｜中国大陆｜营业收入
evidence.excerpt: 主营业务分地区情况；columns: 营业收入、营业成本、毛利率(%)、营业收入比上年增减(%)、营业成本比上年增减(%)、毛利率比上年增减; row: 中国大陆; values: 2634499809.13、1297145816.31、50.76、56.32、51.54、1.55
evidence.review_notes: Confirmed on Piotech FY2023 annual report p57 (pdftotext -layout), table 主营业务分行业、分产品、分地区、分销售模式情况, 分地区 row 中国大陆: 营业收入 2,634,499,809.13, 营业成本 1,297,145,816.31, 毛利率 50.76% -- matches exactly. FLAG for integrator (accepted, not corrected): this row's revenue_basis is 主营业务收入 (the row's own note already confirms this excludes 其他业务收入, citing the company-total residual). The SAME underlying series is already registered elsewhere at category_id=multi_equipment and independently reviewed (PIOTECH2023-MAIN-REV/COST/GM, 'Terra independent verifier', 2026-09-22, sourced from the 分行业 row 半导体设备 on this same page, value 2,634,499,809.13/1,297,145,816.31/50.76% -- identical to this row for FY2023, because Piotech is single-industry, 100%-domestic and 100%-direct-sales this year). Piotech's 分产品 breakdown on this same page shows 主营业务收入 is exactly 薄膜沉积设备+混合键合设备 -- two equipment categories, no other residual -- which by the atlas's own definition (categories.json: multi_equipment = 'a basket of two or more equipment categories that the source does not split') arguably makes this geography row multi_equipment too, matching its 分行业 sibling. I have NOT corrected category_id, for three reasons: (1) every other entity in this batch uses all_businesses uniformly for its own geography-revenue rows, matching the protocol's written rule for a 'company-wide domestic/overseas split', so this looks like the wave's deliberate, consistent design rather than an isolated slip; (2) the registered reporting_scope piotech_mainland_china_main_business has category_id=all_businesses baked into the scope record itself in data/reporting_scopes/piotech.json, and atlas/core.py:101 requires scope.category_id==observation.category_id, so a bare category_id correction would fail validation without a new or repointed scope, which is a registry change outside a reviewer's field-patch authority (and all existing multi_equipment scopes for Piotech are explicitly 分行业-sourced by their own definition text, so repointing to one would misstate which table row this came from); (3) all_businesses rows are excluded from equipment-revenue rollups by policy, so leaving this row as-is is the safer, non-double-counting resting state relative to forcing multi_equipment without a dedicated coincident_value link (which would not even apply cleanly in FY2024/FY2025, where the two rows' values differ by a small amount). This is a registry/taxonomy question worth the integrator's attention, not an extraction defect -- the row as recorded is faithful to the page.

notes: Piotech FY2023 主营业务分地区情况, sole row 中国大陆: company's own narrative confirms 100% of main-business revenue originates in mainland China this year, direct-sales only. Main-business basis confirmed by residual against stated total company revenue (e.g. FY2023: company operating revenue 270,497.40万元 vs this table's 263,449.98万元, gap = 其他业务收入). The margin-change cell prints a signed 1.55 on this page; an earlier draft of the excerpt rendered it as a direction word plus a positive magnitude, which is how the issuer writes it in a different year. Sanjia changed notation between vintages, so the form must be read off each page rather than carried across. COINCIDENT VALUE DECLARED AT W13 REVIEW. This FY2023 figure is also registered at PIOTECH2023-MAIN-REV under scope piotech_piotech_annual_2023_semiconductor_equipment_industry (category multi_equipment), from the 主营业务分行业 row on the same page. Basis distinct_fact_equal_value, not same_fact_restated: 分行业 and 分地区 are parallel partitions of main-business revenue, and they coincide in FY2023 only because Piotech's revenue came entirely from one industry AND one region that year. The perimeters are genuinely distinct, which FY2024 and FY2025 prove — there the 分地区 total exceeds the 半导体设备行业 total by CNY 120,062.96 and CNY 907,535.41 respectively. An aggregation keeps both rows and must never sum across the two partitions. Found by the W13 reviewer of batch C reasoning from the prior-wave record, not by any check: atlas duplicates grouped on reporting_scope_id and could not see this class.
